source_notes: Keep the fall log on a BMS trip. (1) APPROVED (Atlas): logger on its own thread with a ring buffer, fsync every 100 ms, never fsync in the 50 Hz loop. (2) APPROVED WITH CHANGES (Atlas): overcurrent trip gives no warning, so sensing only helps with item 3. LTC3226 datasheet 3226fa: VIN 2.5-5.5 V; SCAP stack programmable 2.5-5.3 V (VSTACK typ 5.3, max 5.5); cell clamp 2.65 V typ; charge current 315 mA (1x) / 157.5 mA (2x) at RPROG 33.3k, input limit 360 mA typ; backup LDO CPO->VOUT, 2 A peak, ILIM min 2 A, FET RDS(on) 200 mOhm (at VCPO 3.6 V), LDO_FB 0.8 V; CAPGOOD at CPO_FB 1.11/1.21 V = ~92% of target. Hold-up (Woz calc, unmeasured): LDO set 4.75 V (above 4.63 V gate); LDO needs CPO >= 4.75 + 1.5 A x (0.2 + 0.06) = 5.14 V; usable 5.30 -> 5.14 V = 0.16 V; t = C dV / I = 5 x 0.16 / 1.5 = ~0.53 s at 1.5 A worst case (supersedes earlier 1.3 s straight-window figure). Charge time (Woz calc): 0 -> 4.8 V at 315 mA (1x) ~76 s + 4.8 -> 5.3 V at 157.5 mA (2x) ~16 s = ~92 s from empty. Boot rule: firmware holds servo torque disabled until CAPGOOD is high (GPIO); a trip before CAPGOOD = no hold-up, log loss bounded by item 1 (<=100 ms) and robot is not moving.
